summary.text: Avishkar is the plane formerly known as Kaladesh, reborn after the Consulate was overthrown.

bio.text: The Consulate was overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution, and Kaladesh was reborn as Avishkar.

status.text: As of the latest event the material records, Avishkar is the reborn Kaladesh after the Consulate's overthrow.
